questions.question:
The material master is grouped into different views or segments based on which factors?
(1) Processes that use the materials
(2) Material type
(3) Organizational level
(4) Material composition
(5) Material description
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1, 2 and 3 – Processes that use the materials; Material type; Organizational level.

questions.question: Which test is the lowest level, executing each individual transaction or process step?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Unit testing.

questions.question: Which statement about business rules and parameters is correct?

options.A: They are set during configuration and seldom change
options.B: They are reset at each posting period
options.D: They are typed by users while processing orders

questions.explanation: Correct answer: They are set during configuration and seldom change.

questions.question: Payment terms offered to vendors are an example of which type of configuration element?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Business rules and parameters.

questions.question: Which type of data is expected to change least often?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Enterprise structure.

questions.question: How are the client and company codes related?

options.A: Clients and company codes are not related
options.B: One client can have several company codes
options.C: One company code contains several clients
options.D: One client can have only one company code

questions.explanation: Correct answer: One client can have several company codes.

questions.question: A US company and a German company buy from the same vendor with different payment terms. How is the vendor handled?

options.A: One set of payment terms applies to both companies
options.B: Payment terms are stored in the chart of accounts
options.C: The vendor is defined only for the first company that buys
options.D: Company code data are maintained separately for each company

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Company code data are maintained separately for each company.

questions.question:
What does the posting key control?
(1) Account type
(2) G/L document number
(3) Posting date
(4) Field status
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1 and 4 – Account type; Field status.

questions.question:
You post an invoice to acquire a new company car. Which account types do you enter in the invoice?
(1) Vendor account
(2) Asset account
(3) G/L expense account
(4) Material account
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 2 and 3 – Asset account; G/L expense account.

questions.question:
What are the benefits of using a business partner in SAP S/4HANA?
(1) Vendors are managed separately from customers
(2) It provides a harmonized architecture
(3) General data is unique to each role
(4) You can maintain multiple addresses for an entity
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 2 and 4 – It provides a harmonized architecture; You can maintain multiple addresses for an entity.

questions.question:
Which of the following organizational levels are defined in SAP S/4HANA Finance?
(1) Segment
(2) Controlling area
(3) Company code
(4) Payroll area
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1 and 3 – Segment; Company code.

questions.question: What do GAAP and IFRS / IAS provide?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Rules for applying accounting concepts.

questions.question: Accounts receivable accounting, which manages customer transactions, is an integral part of which process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Fulfillment.

questions.question: Which organizational unit represents an independent legal accounting entity?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Company code.

questions.question: What is true of a field with the status "Display"?

options.A: It may be filled or left empty
options.B: It must be filled before saving
options.C: Its value is shown but cannot be changed
options.D: It is hidden from the user

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Its value is shown but cannot be changed.

questions.question: How are subledgers and reconciliation accounts posted?

options.A: Both accounts must be posted manually by the user
options.B: The reconciliation account is posted directly, the subledger automatically
options.C: Only the reconciliation account is ever posted
options.D: The subledger is posted directly, the reconciliation account automatically

questions.explanation: Correct answer: The subledger is posted directly, the reconciliation account automatically.

questions.question: Which chart of accounts helps a company meet the legal requirements of each country?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Country-specific chart of accounts.

questions.question: Which master data are most important for a basic financial accounting setup?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: General ledger accounts.

questions.question: A primary cost element is directly associated with which object?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A general ledger account.

questions.question: What do employee tolerance groups control?

options.A: The delivery dates an employee can promise
options.B: The amounts an employee is allowed to post
options.C: The cost centers an employee is paid from
options.D: The number of screens an employee may open

questions.explanation: Correct answer: The amounts an employee is allowed to post.

questions.question: From where does a G/L account inherit its field statuses?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Its account group.

questions.question: How many posting keys does each line item of an accounting document have?

options.A: Two, one for debit and one for credit
options.C: None unless the user adds one

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Exactly one.

questions.question: A G/L account record contains data from which two levels?

options.A: Chart of accounts and company code
options.D: Chart of accounts and cost center

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Chart of accounts and company code.

questions.question: What is the relationship between the general ledger and the chart of accounts?

options.A: The two are completely independent lists
options.B: The general ledger is an instance of the chart of accounts
options.C: The chart of accounts is created from posted documents
options.D: The chart of accounts is a subledger of the general ledger

questions.explanation: Correct answer: The general ledger is an instance of the chart of accounts.

questions.question: What happens to the document number a posting can receive?

options.A: Any number may be typed if a range is full
options.B: It repeats the number of the previous document
options.C: It must fall within the assigned number range
options.D: It is chosen from another company code

questions.explanation: Correct answer: It must fall within the assigned number range.

questions.question: When a company receives a payment from a customer, which account is debited?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Bank.

questions.question: Which chart of accounts supports consolidated reporting for the whole corporate group?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Group chart of accounts.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of general ledger accounting?

options.A: To capture all data from process steps with a financial impact
options.B: To plan the material requirements of every plant
options.C: To manage the physical movement of stock
options.D: To record only the internal costs of departments

questions.explanation: Correct answer: To capture all data from process steps with a financial impact.

questions.question: Which three activities does the statement of cash flows report?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Operating, investing and financing.

questions.question:
What must two company codes have in common if you want to link them to the same controlling area?
(1) Company code currency
(2) Operational chart of accounts
(3) Fiscal year variant
(4) Country
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 2 and 3 – Operational chart of accounts; Fiscal year variant.

questions.question:
Which documents are created when you post a valuated goods receipt for consumable materials?
(1) Sales order document
(2) Accounting document
(3) Vendor invoice document
(4) Controlling document
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 2 and 4 – Accounting document; Controlling document.

questions.question: To how many controlling areas can one company code be assigned?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Exactly one.

questions.question: Which two are overhead management methods?

options.A: Cost center accounting and internal order accounting

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Cost center accounting and internal order accounting.

questions.question: Which statement about cost (management) accounting is correct?

options.A: It is internal and need not follow GAAP or IFRS
options.B: It is audited like the legal financial statements
options.C: It must follow IFRS for external investors
options.D: It must follow GAAP in every country

questions.explanation: Correct answer: It is internal and need not follow GAAP or IFRS.

questions.question: What is meant by external settlement?

options.A: Moving costs from CO to financial accounting, for example to an asset
options.B: Moving costs between two cost centers in CO
options.C: Moving costs from financial accounting into a cost center

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Moving costs from CO to financial accounting, for example to an asset.

questions.question: Which costs make up the cost of production?

options.A: Direct material and direct labor only
options.B: Direct labor and selling expenses only
options.D: Direct material, direct labor and overhead

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Direct material, direct labor and overhead.

questions.question: Which description fits management (cost) accounting?

options.A: Internal accounting focused on managing costs
options.B: Legal reporting to shareholders and tax authorities
options.C: Recording the physical count of inventory
options.D: Recording amounts owed to vendors only

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Internal accounting focused on managing costs.

questions.question: How can a controlling area relate to company codes?

options.A: Controlling areas are assigned to plants only
options.B: One controlling area can include only one company code
options.C: Each company code contains several controlling areas
options.D: One controlling area can include several company codes

questions.explanation: Correct answer: One controlling area can include several company codes.

questions.question: Which description fits overhead costs?

options.B: Costs that are traced directly to one product
options.C: Costs that cannot be traced directly to products or services
options.D: Costs that never appear in controlling

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Costs that cannot be traced directly to products or services.

questions.question: Where do primary cost elements originate?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: In FI general ledger accounts.

questions.question: Where are actual cost transactions posted?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: To individual cost centers.

questions.question: Which pair is basic to setting up overhead accounting in CO?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Cost elements and cost centers.

questions.question: Which statement about posting a goods receipt is correct?

options.A: It can only follow an invoice
options.B: It always needs a reference purchase order
options.C: It always needs a reference sales order
options.D: It can be posted without reference to an order

questions.explanation: Correct answer: It can be posted without reference to an order.

questions.question: Which documents can a goods issue create?

options.A: A purchase order and an invoice

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Material, FI and CO documents.

questions.question: What is the effect of a goods issue on inventory?

options.A: It only changes the storage bin name
options.C: It leaves quantity unchanged but raises value

questions.explanation: Correct answer: It decreases inventory.

questions.question: A purchase requisition is

options.C: A confirmation of an inbound delivery.

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A request to purchase materials..

questions.question:
Which of the steps listed below are part of the procurement process?
(1) Create transfer order
(2) Create requisition
(3) Send payment
(4) Process sales order
(5) Process STO
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 2 and 3 – Create requisition; Send payment.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements concerning the procurement process are TRUE?
(1) Vendor billing is one of the steps.
(2) Only one FI document is created.
(3) Goods receipt is one of the steps.
(4) The send payment step involves creation of an FI document.
(5) Two material documents are created.
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1, 3 and 4 – Vendor billing is one of the steps.; Goods receipt is one of the steps.; The send payment step involves creation of an FI document..

questions.question:
Identify the steps in the procurement process for which an FI document is created.
(1) Goods receipt
(2) Goods issue
(3) Billing
(4) Purchase order
(5) Receive invoice
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1 and 5 – Goods receipt; Receive invoice.

questions.question:
Which of the following are strategies for acquiring materials?
(1) Internally from a vendor
(2) Externally from a storage location
(3) Externally from a plant
(4) Internally from another plant
(5) Externally from a vendor
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 4 and 5 – Internally from another plant; Externally from a vendor.

questions.question:
Identify the GL entries that are posted when a payment is sent to a vendor.
(1) The vendor account is credited,
(2) The vendor account is debited.
(3) The accounts payable reconciliation account is debited.
(4) The bank account is credited.
(5) The bank account is debited.
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 2, 3 and 4 – The vendor account is debited.; The accounts payable reconciliation account is debited.; The bank account is credited..

questions.question: Which one of the steps listed most likely would be the final step in the procurement process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Send payment.

questions.question: In which of the following processes is a material document NOT created?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Warehouse management.

questions.question: Receive invoice is a step in which process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Procurement.

questions.question: A company has decided to acquire materials via internal procurement. What is the likely next step?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Create an STO.

questions.question: Which one of the following statements about the goods receipt step in the procurement process is TRUE?

options.A: Both FI and material documents are created.
options.B: One material document is created, but no FI documents are.
options.C: No FI or material documents are created.

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Both FI and material documents are created..

questions.question: In the procurement process, a purchase requisition is created during which step?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Requirements determination.

questions.question: What is the FI effect of a goods receipt posting in the external procurement process?

options.A: No financial effect takes place at this step, so no FI document is created.
options.B: Debit and credit to the inventory account

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Debit inventory, credit GR/IR.

questions.question: What is the general ledger impact when a vendor invoice is received and verified?

options.A: Debit GR/IR, credit vendor subledger account
options.B: Debit vendor subledger account, debit GR/IR
options.D: Debit vendor subledger account, credit COGS

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Debit GR/IR, credit vendor subledger account.

questions.question: Which of these is a step of the procurement process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Purchase requisition.

questions.question: Creating a purchase order is a step in which process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Procurement.

questions.question: Which accounting impact does the invoice receipt step in procurement normally have?

options.A: Only a change in material quantity
options.B: Neither an FI nor a CO impact
options.C: An FI impact without a CO impact
options.D: A CO impact without an FI impact

questions.explanation: Correct answer: An FI impact without a CO impact.

questions.question: In which step is a purchase requisition converted into a purchase order?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Purchase order processing.

questions.question: In internal procurement, which price is used to value the goods issue posting?

options.B: Valuation price at the sending plant
options.C: Price on the last vendor quotation
options.D: Valuation price at the receiving plant

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Valuation price at the sending plant.

questions.question: In internal procurement between plants (two-step), what is created at goods receipt?

options.B: An FI document but no material document
options.C: Both a material and an FI document
options.D: A material document but no FI document

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A material document but no FI document.

questions.question: At goods receipt in external procurement for one material, how many line items does the material document have?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: One.

questions.question: What is posted to the GR/IR account when a vendor invoice is received?

options.A: Both a debit and a credit

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A debit.

questions.question: Which step typically starts the procurement process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Creating a purchase requisition.

questions.question: What does valuation at plant level allow?

options.A: The same material can have different values in different plants
options.B: Only the company code can hold stock
options.D: The material must have one price in all plants

questions.explanation: Correct answer: The same material can have different values in different plants.

questions.question: Which organizational unit negotiates purchasing conditions with vendors and is responsible for procurement?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Purchasing organization.

questions.question:
Which of the steps listed below are part of the fulfillment process.
(1) Purchase order sent to vendor
(2) Goods receipt posted
(3) Billing
(4) STO processing
(5) Sales order processing
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 3 and 5 – Billing; Sales order processing.

questions.question:
The sales order processing step in the fulfillment process includes which of the following activities?
(1) Materials are shipped.
(2) An availability check is executed.
(3) A goods receipt is posted.
(4) A sales order is created.
(5) A goods issue is posted.
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 2 and 4 – An availability check is executed.; A sales order is created..

questions.question:
The shipping step involves which of the following activities?
(1) Creating a delivery document.
(2) Authorizing picking, packing, and goods issue.
(3) Processing a purchase order.
(4) Authorizing picking, packing, and goods receipt.
(5) Creating a transfer order.
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1 and 2 – Creating a delivery document.; Authorizing picking, packing, and goods issue..

questions.question:
What are the GL entries when a customer invoice is generated?
(1) The accounts payable reconciliation account is debited.
(2) The accounts receivable reconciliation account is debited.
(3) The customer subledger account is debited.
(4) The revenue account is credited.
(5) The vendor subledger account is credited.
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 2, 3 and 4 – The accounts receivable reconciliation account is debited.; The customer subledger account is debited.; The revenue account is credited..

questions.question: Shipping, billing, and payment are steps in which process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Fulfillment.

questions.question: Identify the step in the fulfillment process for which a material document is created.
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Goods issue.

questions.question: What is the general ledger impact of the goods issue step in the fulfillment process?

options.C: Debit and credit to the inventory account

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Debit COGS, credit inventory.

questions.question: Calculate the debit and credit for the goods issue step in the fulfillment process, based on the following data. (Note: You need to pick the right price for this calculation.) Materials sold (trading goods): Printers Quantities sold: 100 Price for customer: $120.00 Current average moving price: $85.00 Price from vendor: $84.00 Average price 30 days before customer order was placed: $86.00
questions.explanation: Correct answer: $8,500.

questions.question: What is the GL entry when a company receives a payment from a customer?

options.C: Debit bank, credit customer, credit accounts reconciliation account
options.D: Debit accounts reconciliation account, debit customer, credit bank

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Debit bank, credit customer, credit accounts reconciliation account.

questions.question: During fulfillment, which process can the availability check trigger when stock is insufficient?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Procurement.

questions.question: Which fulfillment step has a controlling (CO) impact when goods leave the warehouse?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Goods issue.

questions.question: Which document does the shipping step create first?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Outbound delivery document.

questions.question: What is the purpose of an outbound delivery document?

options.A: To record the payment from the customer
options.B: To request materials from the purchasing department
options.C: To request moving materials from one plant to another
options.D: To authorize picking, packing and shipping to a customer

questions.explanation: Correct answer: To authorize picking, packing and shipping to a customer.

questions.question: The amount posted at goods issue in fulfillment is based on which price?

options.A: Sales price on the customer order
options.B: Current moving average price of the material
options.D: Price on the latest customer quotation

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Current moving average price of the material.

questions.question: When a customer payment is received, which account is updated automatically?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Accounts receivable reconciliation account.

questions.question: What is the correct sequence of steps in the order-to-cash business process?

options.A: Create sales order Check availability Process a delivery document Post goods issue
options.B: Check availability Create sales order Post goods issue Billing
options.C: Check availability Create sales order Billing Post goods issue
options.D: Create sales order Check availability Plan transportation Post goods issue

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Create sales order Check availability Process a delivery document Post goods issue.

questions.question:
What does the material ledger in SAP S/4HANA enable?
(1) Reporting for parallel accounting
(2) Reporting of all materials required during maintenance processing
(3) Material valuation in multiple currencies
(4) Recording of all business transactions
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1 and 3 – Reporting for parallel accounting; Material valuation in multiple currencies.

questions.question:
At which points in the order-to-cash process are postings made to the general ledger?
(1) Saving the sales order
(2) Confirming a transfer order
(3) Posting a goods issue
(4) Saving the invoice
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 3 and 4 – Posting a goods issue; Saving the invoice.

questions.question:
What happens when you post a goods issue for a delivery document in sales?
(1) An invoice is created
(2) Inventory quantities are updated
(3) An accounting journal entry is created
(4) A warehouse transfer order is created
(5) The billing due list is updated
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 2, 3 and 5 – Inventory quantities are updated; An accounting journal entry is created; The billing due list is updated.

questions.question:
Which of the following are variations of the basic fulfillment process?
(1) Quote to cash
(2) Procure to pay
(3) Requisition to pay
(4) Inquiry to cash
(5) Plan to produce
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1 and 4 – Quote to cash; Inquiry to cash.

questions.question: Payment terms are declared by the buyer at what step?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Purchase Order.

questions.question:
Which of the following are documents associated with the fulfillment process?
(1) Picking list (picking request)
(2) Packing list
(3) Bill material
(4) Customer master
(5) Customer invoice
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1, 2 and 5 – Picking list (picking request); Packing list; Customer invoice. Note: Picking list, packing list and customer invoice are all fulfillment documents. (corrected from the source file)

questions.question: Which set of organizational elements is essential to the fulfillment process?

options.A: Client, purchasing group, work center, plant
options.B: Client, company code, sales area, plant
options.C: Company code, purchasing organization, payroll area
options.D: Controlling area, cost center, asset class

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Client, company code, sales area, plant.

questions.question: Which of the following types of data is NOT included in a quotation?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Vendor master.

questions.question:
Organizational data in a delivery document consist of which of the following?
(1) Client
(2) Company Code
(3) Quantity
(4) Shedule lines
(5) Shipping point
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1, 2 and 5 – Client; Company Code; Shipping point. Note: Client, company code and shipping point are organisational data; quantity and schedule lines are not. (corrected from the source file)

questions.question: What document is NOT created during the billing step of fulfillment process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A material document.

questions.question: A company does not have enough stock for a customer order, so it ships what it has now and will ship the rest later. Which term best describes the remaining quantity?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Backorder.

questions.question: Which one of the following represents the correct order of process steps for fulfillment process?

options.A: Pre-sales activity, payment, sales order processing, inventory sourcing, shipping, billing
options.B: Pre-sales activity, sales order processing, shipping, billing, inventory sourcing, payment
options.C: Pre-sales activity, sales order processing, inventory sourcing, shipping, billing, payment
options.D: Sales order processing, pre-sales activity, inventory sourcing, billing, billing, payment

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Pre-sales activity, sales order processing, inventory sourcing, shipping, billing, payment.

questions.question: When using an ES, the person responsible for preparing shipments can retrieve a list of orders that need to be shipped. Such a list is called
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Delivery due list. Note: Orders waiting to be shipped are listed in the delivery due list; the billing due list is for invoicing. (corrected from the source file)

questions.question: In fulfillment process, which department prepares and sends the shipment?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Warehouse.

questions.question: Which of the following organizational levels is NOT relevant to the fulfillment process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Purchasing organization.

questions.question: Which of the following organizational levels is associated with the method used to distribute material to a customer?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Distribution chanel.

questions.question: Which reporting options does SAP ERP system support?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: All of the above.

questions.question: Material master data are grouped into views. Which one of the following combination of views is relevant to the fulfillment process?

options.A: Basic data, company data, sales plant data
options.B: Basic data, sales organization data, client data
options.C: Client data, sales area data, sales plant data
options.D: Basic data, sales organization data, sales plant data

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Basic data, sales organization data, sales plant data.

questions.question:
What are the partner functions that customers can play in the fulfillment process?
(1) Sold-to-party
(2) Bill-to-party
(3) Ship-to-party
(4) Receiver
(5) Payer
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1, 2, 3 and 5 – Sold-to-party; Bill-to-party; Ship-to-party; Payer. Note: The four partner functions are sold-to, ship-to, bill-to and payer. (corrected from the source file)

questions.question: What is the final step in the fulfillment process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Receipt payment from customer.

questions.question: Pre-sales activity includes all of the follwing except
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Customer purchase orders.

questions.question: Which of the following statement regarding customer master data is NOT true?

options.A: They include data that are stored at client level
options.B: They contain data that are need to make postings in FI
options.C: They are valid for a specific sales area
options.D: They include that are needed to make postings in CO

questions.explanation: Correct answer: They include that are needed to make postings in CO.

questions.question:
Typically, which of the following information would you find in an invoice?
(1) Bill to address
(2) Ship to address
(3) Quantity
(4) Requested delivery date
(5) Price
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1, 2, 3 and 5 – Bill to address; Ship to address; Quantity; Price.

questions.question:
Material master data in a delivery document consist of which of the following? (Material master data trong một delivery document bao gồm)13
(1) Material description
(2) Unit of measure
(3) Quantity
(4) Weight
(5) Billing date
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1, 2 and 4 – Material description; Unit of measure; Weight.

questions.question:
Which of the following steps in the fulfillment process have an impact on the financials of the company receiving the order from customer?
(1) Receive customer inquiry
(2) Send quotation
(3) Receive customer purchase order
(4) Send shipment
(5) Receive customer payment
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 4 and 5 – Send shipment; Receive customer payment.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a key step in the fulfillment process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Pre-sales activity.

questions.question:
Which one of the following are examples of sales units?
(1) Cartons
(2) Data
(3) Crates
(4) Barrels
(5) Cases
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1, 3, 4 and 5 – Cartons; Crates; Barrels; Cases.

questions.question: How many loading points can one shipping point have?

options.B: One for each sales area only

questions.explanation: Correct answer: None, one or several.

questions.question: What makes up a sales area?

options.B: Sales organization, distribution channel and division
options.C: Company code, plant and storage location

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Sales organization, distribution channel and division.

questions.question: To how many company codes can one sales organization be assigned?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Only one.

questions.question: What does the standard SAP system provide for its standard condition types?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: Predefined access sequences.

questions.question:
How can you post internal labor costs to a network activity?
(1) Confirmation
(2) Service entry sheet
(3) Distribution
(4) Activity allocation
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 1 and 4 – Confirmation; Activity allocation.

questions.question: What are the process steps in corrective maintenance?

options.A: Create Task List Create Plan Schedule Plan Complete Order Billing
options.B: Create Task List Create Plan Schedule Plan Release Order Complete Order
options.C: Create Notification Create Order Release Order Execute Order Complete Order
options.D: Create Notification Release Order Execute Order Complete Order Billing

questions.explanation: Correct answer: Create Notification Create Order Release Order Execute Order Complete Order.

questions.question:
Which objects can you settle?
(1) Cost center
(2) Maintenance order
(3) Profitability segment
(4) Work breakdown structure (WBS) element
Choose the correct combination:
questions.explanation: Correct items: 2 and 4 – Maintenance order; Work breakdown structure (WBS) element. Note: Maintenance orders and WBS elements are senders that can be settled; cost centers are allocated, not settled. (corrected from the source file)
